author: ChatGPT Pro
scope: Hand-constructed representational counterexample, not learned weights, not UR1 success, not length extrapolation
cases: All 256 binary input questions of exactly eight bits, once each in numeric order
student_input: Only Q plus its own generated 0/1 prefix; no delimiter, cursor, Q length or target length feature
remaining_hidden: All other incoming weights, biases and outgoing weights are zero
optimization: No step, lesson, loss_grad or optimizer call; no parameter search or alternative construction
expected_scoring_only: Q plus external STOP; expected output is constructed after generation and is never passed into forward
